name: Club Salad
description: A layered salad featuring romaine lettuce, bacon, eggs, cheese, chicken, carrots, and tomatoes, topped with ranch dressing or dip.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup ranch or dip dressing
¾ cup grated cheese (marble, cheddar, etc.)

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Caesar Salad
_similar.description: A classic Caesar salad recipe with romaine lettuce, crumbled bacon, croutons, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Rub salad bowl with garlic.
Wash and tear lettuce. Dry in a tea towel.
Place lettuce in bowl with bacon and croutons.
Blend dressing ingredients together.
Pour dressing over salad and toss until leaves are coated.
Serve with freshly grated Parmesan.

_similar.keywords: Caesar salad, bacon, croutons, homemade dressing

Toss chicken, grapes, celery, and almonds together.

_similar.name: Marinated Vegetable Salad
_similar.description: A colorful salad of marinated vegetables including cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, and radishes, dressed with Italian dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean all the vegetables, then drain well.
Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim radishes and carrots; leave whole or cut into bite-sized pieces if large.
Cut celery into 3-inch pieces and slice cucumber into 1/2-inch slices.
Leave cherry tomatoes whole and place all vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour Italian dressing over the vegetables and let set for a few hours.
Serve as finger food or as a salad.

_similar.keywords: marinated vegetables, vegetable salad, Italian dressing
